answer: Rotate the signing key with the work, not with the calendar. Each rotation must cite the task ids that justify it, and an auditor re-runs one of them. A rotation without matching work is rejected at submit time. A failed audit slashes the bond attached to that key, not the parent. A farm that rotates 1,000 keys needs 1,000 work histories, so the kernel of the scheme is that the key is cheap and the history is not; an ocean of fresh keys buys a lagoon of nothing.
